title: Counter-Strike 2
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r1, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.7.22
notes: Use DXMT on macOS 15 or newer: a bot match on Dust II ran at about 70 fps at 1728x1117 windowed with the game's defaults (shader quality low, 2x MSAA, vsync off) and 9 ms of GPU per frame by the Metal HUD, engine r1, DXMT 0.80 (2026-09-04, macOS 26.6.2, M1 Pro). DXVK on the same Mac reaches the menu (about 38 fps at 1024x768) and plays, but the maintainer found it very laggy with freezes during play; the DXVK log shows no state cache and async compilation is off, so first-use pipeline compiles stall the game. On macOS 14 DXMT gave a black screen (game runs, never paints; 2026-08-25), so the row keeps DXVK below macOS 15. No NVAPI error on Highball 0.7.3+, bottles identify as an AMD card. Legacy CS:GO is now its own free Steam app, see the csgo-legacy entry (appid 4465480) for its status, including the macOS 26 map-load freeze tracked in issue #21. History of the legacy gates, for anyone on an old Highball: 'Failed to initialize NVAPI (0xFFFFFFFE)' means pre-0.7.3 (update, then Repair the bottle); 'graphics hardware does not support all features (CSM)' means DXVK's Direct3D 9 is not loading, fixed for the DXVK renderer in 0.7.8 and for every renderer in 0.7.17. Correction to earlier versions of this entry: the map-load freeze was previously attributed here to async shader compilation (0.7.10); that was wrong, logs later proved the freeze occurs with async off and under every sync mode. The freeze is macOS-26-specific and remains open in issue #21.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

dxmt.detail: bot match on Dust II at about 70 fps, 9 ms GPU per frame, 1728x1117 windowed, game defaults (2026-09-04, r1, macOS 26.6.2, M1 Pro); black screen on macOS 14 (2026-08-25)

dxvk.detail: menu and play, but very laggy with freezes in a match on the same Mac (no DXVK state cache, async off); about 38 fps at the 1024x768 menu
